_synthetic: Written synthetic-from-a-received-message, made-up values: a message whose one link the sender's client previewed, read from the user's own store locally (never copied: every word, link and id here is made up), in the shape it had. Its text is one paragraph holding the link's anchor; properties.links is a JSON string of a list: @type http://schema.skype.com/HyperLink, itemid, url, previewenabled true, and preview with description, previewMetadata (height and width as numbers), previewurl (the async gateway's urlp Thumbnail link, the page's picture its url) and title. A second entry, whose preview the sender turned off (previewenabled false, as a captured channel post's link had it), is made up beside it. The real message also carried skipfanouttobots and languageStamp. <guid:a>, <guid:b> are lab accounts' object ids; tests fill them in. See docs/protocol/chat.md, Link previews.
